description: This file contains the Controller class for managing customer groups in the OpenCart admin interface, including generating, listing, retrieving info, and clearing customer group data and related files.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing customer group data, generating JSON files, and handling related administrative tasks.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates all customer group data, clears old data, initiates tasks related to customer groups.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates JSON list of customer groups for a store, saves it to a file.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific customer group, including descriptions and custom fields, and saves it to a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing customer group JSON files from the server.
